history.name: Recording a change to something that exists
history.description: When an existing capability changes, the record takes its full current-state description — rewritten, not a diff — together with the bullets saying what it was before and why it moved. Both are kept: the description is what every future reader sees, and the bullets are what the release it changed in is remembered for. A second edit within the same release merges into the same entry rather than adding a duplicate.
history.dev_notes: cmdUpdate. Creates or amends the history entry at the working version; the current-state description is what stateAt() returns from then on.
